dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts federal agency personnel tasked with placing plaques and honors Downwinder communities in New Mexico.
dimensions.evidence: commemorate the Downwinder communities of New Mexico.

dimensions.assessment: Purely honorific and commemorative action involving three physical plaques.
dimensions.evidence: shall jointly obtain three honorific plaques of an appropriate design

dimensions.assessment: Incurs only the nominal administrative cost of acquiring and placing three plaques.
Narrow directive requiring specific federal agency heads to install plaques at three designated federal locations in New Mexico.
dimensions.evidence: place one plaque at an appropriate, publicly accessible location at the White Sands Missile Range

dimensions.assessment: Permanent placement of physical monuments, though the required action must be completed within one year.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Exact cost of designing, purchasing, and installing the three plaques.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs three federal secretaries to jointly obtain and place three honorific plaques in New Mexico to commemorate Downwinder communities, representing a localized, symbolic measure with minimal operational or economic impact.
